faqs.question: What information do I need to provide?
faqs.answer: Basic contact details along with your property's type, location, area and what you're looking to do with it (sale, rental or joint venture). Anything else can be added under Additional Details.

faqs.question: Can I list residential and commercial property?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our form covers residential property types such as apartments, villas and independent houses, as well as commercial properties.

faqs.question: Can you help with land and plots?
faqs.answer: Yes, land and plots are among the property types we regularly assist with — for sale, investment or joint development purposes.

faqs.question: How does property marketing work?
faqs.answer: Once we understand your property, our team presents it clearly to genuine buyers, tenants or investors within our network, based on its category and location.

faqs.question: Can I list a property for lease?
faqs.answer: Yes — select "Rental / Leasing" under Listing Requirement in the form and our team will assist accordingly.

faqs.question: Can you assist with joint development opportunities?
faqs.answer: Yes. If your land may be suited for joint development, select "Joint Venture" in the form and our team will discuss the possibilities with you.

faqs.question: What happens after I submit my property?
faqs.answer: Our team reviews the details you've shared and gets in touch to discuss your property and the next steps.

fields.text: Share your property details and our team will get in touch to discuss the best way forward.
